name: Caçador (Brazil)
description: Purple-blue field with a saltire of white and red stripes and a white cross, charged at the centre with a white rectangle bearing the municipal arms.
history: Caçador is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted in 1966 (prescribed with the arms by Municipal Law No. 27 of 1966 and regulated by Decree No. 7,299 of 26 October 2017, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: saltire of white and red stripes
central rectangle bearing the municipal arms
municipal arms with a mural crown, reading CAÇADOR
